title: Towards Certificate-Driven Software Porting: A Self-Improving Agentic Harness for Scientific Program Optimization
title_zh: Certificate-驱动的软件移植：一种自改进代理框架用于科学程序优化

paragraphs.en: Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences
paragraphs.zh: 机器学习与物理科学

paragraphs.en: The upgrade and rewriting of large scientific codebases has traditionally been a major challenge. While evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can port and accelerate legacy code, repair feedback in prompts alone does not prevent subsequent candidates from repeating the same errors. We introduce Certificate-Driven Evolutionary Search (CDES), which extends evolutionary search with enforceable restrictions derived from failed candidates, recorded as certificates of assumptions, checker evidence, and justified restrictions. Its control logic enforces these restrictions through rejection, backtracking, and targeted repair while preserving compatible edits. We apply CDES to CPU-to-GPU translation of two particle-simulation functions from the Geant4 toolkit, evaluated with a harness that goes beyond unit tests to combine formal checks, numerical comparisons, physics checks, and GPU safety tests. Generated implementations achieve 13.78 × \times and 23.54 × \times function-level speedups over CPU code, including data conversion and transfers; for one function, GPU throughput exceeds an expert implementation by 14.9%, reaching 16.1% when complementary components are combined. In an ablation over execution settings, certificate feedback increases the fraction of candidates passing required correctness checks from 55% to 90%.
paragraphs.zh: 大型科学代码库的升级和重写历来是一项重大挑战。 虽然结合大语言模型（LLM）的演化搜索可以移植并加速遗留代码，但仅通过提示词中的反馈进行修复，并不能防止后续候选方案重复出现相同的错误。 我们提出了证书驱动演化搜索（CDES），它将演化搜索扩展为包含从失败候选方案中推导出的可强制执行限制，这些限制被记录为假设证书、检查器证据和合理限制。 其控制逻辑通过拒绝、回溯和针对性修复来强制执行这些限制，同时保留兼容的修改。 我们将 CDES 应用于 Geant4 工具包中两个粒子模拟函数从 CPU 到 GPU 的转换，并使用一个超越单元测试的测试框架进行评估，该框架结合了形式化检查、数值比较、物理检查和 GPU 安全测试。 生成的实现相较于 CPU 代码在函数级别实现了 13.78 × \times 和 23.54 × \times 的性能提升，包括数据转换和传输；对于其中一个函数，GPU 吞吐量比专家实现的版本高出 14.9%，当结合互补组件时，这一比例可达 16.1%。 在执行设置的消融研究中，证书反馈将通过正确性检查的候选方案比例从 55% 提高到了 90%。

paragraphs.en: Scientific software is often developed and extended by the community over several decades, making it challenging to rewrite the entire codebase whenever new hardware acceleration paradigms emerge. Simulators are of particular interest because they consume a substantial amount of computational time, for instance in physics and astrophysics research [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . There is therefore great interest in faster implementations of simulation software that preserve computational and physical specifications. Geant4 is a particle simulation toolkit widely used for detector simulation in particle physics experiments and for applications in medical imaging [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . While porting the entirety of Geant4 to GPU-accelerated code is a herculean task, the Celeritas project has taken a significant step by designing expert-written GPU implementations for particle transport [ 8 ] . In this proof-of-concept study, we explore how automated optimization can complement these efforts by improving existing implementations and accelerating functions for which no expert-written GPU implementations exist. For this approach to scale to the entire codebase, we assume that selected functions can be optimized independently, and that speeding up individual components will reduce overall simulation time. We evaluate function-level performance here, leaving full-simulation gains to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 科学软件通常由社区在数十年间不断开发和扩展，因此每当出现新的硬件加速范式时，重写整个代码库便是一项极具挑战性的任务。 模拟器尤其值得关注，因为它们会消耗大量计算时间，例如在物理学和天体物理学研究中 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] 。 因此，人们非常关注能够保留计算和物理规范、同时实现更快运行速度的模拟软件。 Geant4 是一种粒子模拟工具包，广泛应用于粒子物理学实验中的探测器模拟以及医学成像领域 [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] 。 尽管将 Geant4 的全部代码移植到 GPU 加速版本是一项极其艰巨的任务，但 Celeritas 项目通过为粒子输运设计由专家编写的 GPU 实现，迈出了重要一步 [ 8 ] 。 在这项概念验证研究中，我们探讨了自动化优化如何能够补充这些努力：通过改进现有实现，并加速那些尚无专家编写 GPU 实现的函数。 为了使这种方法能够扩展到整个代码库，我们假设所选函数可以独立优化，并且加快单个组件的速度将缩短整体模拟时间。 本文评估了函数级别的性能提升，而完整模拟中的性能增益则留待未来研究。

paragraphs.en: CDES builds on state-of-the-art evolutionary program search, where systems such as FunSearch, AlphaEvolve, ERA, and MadEvolve repeatedly generate, evaluate, and select programs [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] . Our focus is on how information from failed candidates can be converted into enforceable restrictions on subsequent search. The certificate database provides feedback to the mutator LLM, but CDES does not rely on prompt compliance alone. Its control logic separately enforces validated restrictions on candidate choices, rejecting conflicting choices and guiding the repair process. This design works with frontier LLMs through API calls and requires neither access to model weights nor additional training. It draws on symbolic feedback in RLSF [ 13 ] , constrained reinforcement learning in CDRL [ 14 ] , and conflict learning for program construction in Neo [ 15 ] .
paragraphs.zh: CDES 建立在当前最先进的进化程序搜索技术之上，其中 FunSearch、AlphaEvolve、ERA 和 MadEvolve 等系统会反复生成、评估和选择程序 [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] 。 我们的研究重点在于如何将失败候选体的信息转化为对后续搜索具有约束力的限制条件。 证书数据库为变异 LLM 提供反馈，但 CDES 并不仅仅依赖提示的合规性。 其控制逻辑会单独对候选选择施加已验证的限制，拒绝冲突的选择并引导修复过程。 该设计通过 API 调用与前沿 LLM 协同工作，既不需要访问模型权重，也不需要额外训练。 它借鉴了 RLSF [ 13 ] 中的符号反馈、CDRL [ 14 ] 中的约束强化学习以及 Neo [ 15 ] 中用于程序构建的冲突学习机制。

paragraphs.en: We make two contributions. First, a certificate-driven evolutionary search mechanism converts conflicts into verified restrictions and enforces them through targeted rejection and repair while preserving compatible changes. Second, a scientific optimization and evaluation harness integrates this mechanism with tool selection and correctness checks to translate CPU programs into CUDA, NVIDIA’s GPU programming platform. The search is self-improving because accumulated certificates change which future modifications are permitted, without retraining the LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了两项贡献。 首先，一种以证书驱动的演化搜索机制将冲突转化为经过验证的限制，并通过有针对性的拒绝和修复来强制执行这些限制，同时保留兼容的变更。 其次，一个科学优化与评估框架将该机制与工具选择和正确性检查相结合，从而将 CPU 程序转换为 NVIDIA 的 GPU 编程平台 CUDA。 这种搜索具有自我改进能力，因为累积的证书会改变未来允许进行的修改，而无需重新训练 LLM。

sents.en: We make two contributions.
sents.zh: 我们提出了两项贡献。

sents.en: First, a certificate-driven evolutionary search mechanism converts conflicts into verified restrictions and enforces them through targeted rejection and repair while preserving compatible changes.

sents.zh: 这种搜索具有自我改进能力，因为累积的证书会改变未来允许进行的修改，而无需重新训练 LLM。

paragraphs.en: CDES extends an AlphaEvolve-style core implemented with ShinkaEvolve [ 16 ] (Figure 1 ). A seed initializes the program database. Parent selection chooses a stored program, and the mutator LLM proposes code or execution settings. The evaluation harness returns programs and scores to the program database and failures to the certificate database. CDES adds backtracking, restarting, and targeted repair.
paragraphs.zh: CDES 采用基于 ShinkaEvolve [ 16 ] 实现的 AlphaEvolve 风格核心（图 1）。 一个种子用于初始化程序数据库。 父本选择环节会挑选一个已存储的程序，而变异 LLM 则会提出代码或执行设置建议。 评估框架会将程序和评分返回至程序数据库，并将失败记录返回至证书数据库。 CDES 增加了回溯、重启和针对性修复功能。

sents.en: CDES extends an AlphaEvolve-style core implemented with ShinkaEvolve [ 16 ] (Figure 1 ).
sents.zh: CDES 采用基于 ShinkaEvolve [ 16 ] 实现的 AlphaEvolve 风格核心（图 1）。

sents.en: A seed initializes the program database.
sents.zh: 一个种子用于初始化程序数据库。

sents.en: Parent selection chooses a stored program, and the mutator LLM proposes code or execution settings.
sents.zh: 父本选择环节会挑选一个已存储的程序，而变异 LLM 则会提出代码或执行设置建议。

sents.en: The evaluation harness returns programs and scores to the program database and failures to the certificate database.
sents.zh: 评估框架会将程序和评分返回至程序数据库，并将失败记录返回至证书数据库。

sents.en: CDES adds backtracking, restarting, and targeted repair.
sents.zh: CDES 增加了回溯、重启和针对性修复功能。

paragraphs.en: Detection and certification. The evaluation harness detects requirement violations. The conflict checker and analyzer reviews unfinished candidates using stored certificates and symbolic checks of dependencies between code components. A certificate records the conflicting choices, the violated requirement, and supporting assumptions and evidence. Proposed restrictions are checked before being used to block the same conflict in later candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 检测与认证。 评估框架会检测需求违规情况。 冲突检查器和分析器会利用已存储的证书以及对代码组件间依赖关系的符号化检查，来审查未完成的候选方案。 一份证书会记录冲突的选择、被违反的需求，以及相关的假设和证据。 在将拟定的限制措施用于阻止后续候选方案中出现相同冲突之前，必须先对其进行检查。

sents.en: Detection and certification.
sents.zh: 检测与认证。

sents.en: The evaluation harness detects requirement violations.
sents.zh: 评估框架会检测需求违规情况。

sents.en: The conflict checker and analyzer reviews unfinished candidates using stored certificates and symbolic checks of dependencies between code components.
sents.zh: 冲突检查器和分析器会利用已存储的证书以及对代码组件间依赖关系的符号化检查，来审查未完成的候选方案。

sents.en: A certificate records the conflicting choices, the violated requirement, and supporting assumptions and evidence.
sents.zh: 一份证书会记录冲突的选择、被违反的需求，以及相关的假设和证据。

sents.en: Proposed restrictions are checked before being used to block the same conflict in later candidates.
sents.zh: 在将拟定的限制措施用于阻止后续候选方案中出现相同冲突之前，必须先对其进行检查。

paragraphs.en: Undo and targeted repair. CDES control logic rejects conflicting combinations, adds required components, and repairs choices while preserving compatible edits. Conflict-driven clause learning (CDCL) SAT solvers determine whether Boolean choices satisfy logical constraints. They learn restrictions from conflicts and backjump to earlier decisions [ 17 ] . CDES similarly backtracks, restarts, or repairs candidates, without claiming that no solution exists. Unlike prompt feedback, validated restrictions are enforced even when the LLM repeats a conflicting proposal.
paragraphs.zh: 撤销与目标修复。 CDES 控制逻辑会拒绝冲突的组合，添加必要组件，并在保留兼容编辑的同时修复选择。 冲突驱动子句学习（CDCL）的 SAT 求解器用于判断布尔选择是否满足逻辑约束。 它们从冲突中学习限制条件，并回跳至更早的决定 [ 17 ] 。 CDES 也会以类似方式回溯、重启或修复候选项，但不会断言不存在解。 与提示反馈不同，即使 LLM 重复提出冲突的提议，已验证的限制条件仍会被强制执行。

sents.zh: 撤销与目标修复。

sents.zh: CDES 控制逻辑会拒绝冲突的组合，添加必要组件，并在保留兼容编辑的同时修复选择。

sents.zh: 冲突驱动子句学习（CDCL）的 SAT 求解器用于判断布尔选择是否满足逻辑约束。

sents.en: They learn restrictions from conflicts and backjump to earlier decisions [ 17 ] .
sents.zh: 它们从冲突中学习限制条件，并回跳至更早的决定 [ 17 ] 。

sents.en: CDES similarly backtracks, restarts, or repairs candidates, without claiming that no solution exists.
sents.zh: CDES 也会以类似方式回溯、重启或修复候选项，但不会断言不存在解。

sents.en: Unlike prompt feedback, validated restrictions are enforced even when the LLM repeats a conflicting proposal.
sents.zh: 与提示反馈不同，即使 LLM 重复提出冲突的提议，已验证的限制条件仍会被强制执行。

paragraphs.en: Related ideas appear in program analysis and synthesis. Prior work uses program summaries and simplified models to guide search [ 18 , 19 ] , identifies conditions under which rewrites preserve behavior [ 20 ] , and aligns states across program executions [ 21 ] . Other approaches check unfinished programs [ 22 ] or infer properties preserved across loop iterations [ 23 ] . CDES draws on these directions to guide tool requests and the construction of reusable restrictions, rather than implementing each method directly.
paragraphs.zh: 相关思想也出现在程序分析与合成领域。 先前的研究利用程序摘要和简化模型来指导搜索 [ 18 , 19 ]，识别重写操作保持行为不变的条件 [ 20]，并对不同程序执行中的状态进行对齐 [ 21]。 其他方法则检查未完成程序 [ 22]，或推断在循环迭代间保持不变的属性 [ 23]。 CDES 借鉴了这些方向来指导工具请求和可重用约束的构建，而非直接实现每种方法。

sents.zh: 相关思想也出现在程序分析与合成领域。

sents.en: CDES draws on these directions to guide tool requests and the construction of reusable restrictions, rather than implementing each method directly.
sents.zh: CDES 借鉴了这些方向来指导工具请求和可重用约束的构建，而非直接实现每种方法。

paragraphs.en: Geant4 source and specifications define expected behavior, with Celeritas as an expert performance reference where available. An evaluator LLM selects and orders tools, while a fixed policy mandates checks described below [ 24 ] . Each evaluation result records a hash identifying the exact candidate source code tested. Failed or unresolved mandatory checks block acceptance and enter the certificate database. Separate validation suites test additional workload sizes, fresh random-number sequences, and inputs near numerical decision boundaries. Their results are withheld from the corresponding search runs rather than used to guide proposals.
paragraphs.zh: Geant4 源代码和规格定义了预期的行为，而 Celeritas 在可用时则作为性能基准参考。 评估 LLM 负责选择和排序工具，同时一项固定策略强制要求执行下文描述的检查 [ 24 ] 。 每次评估结果都会记录一个哈希值，用于标识所测试的精确候选源代码。 未通过或未解决的强制性检查将阻止接受该结果，并将其录入证书数据库。 独立的验证套件会测试额外的工作负载规模、全新的随机数序列以及接近数值决策边界的输入。 这些结果不会被用于相应的搜索运行，而是被排除在外，不会用来指导提案。

sents.zh: Geant4 源代码和规格定义了预期的行为，而 Celeritas 在可用时则作为性能基准参考。

sents.zh: 评估 LLM 负责选择和排序工具，同时一项固定策略强制要求执行下文描述的检查 [ 24 ] 。

sents.zh: 每次评估结果都会记录一个哈希值，用于标识所测试的精确候选源代码。

sents.zh: 独立的验证套件会测试额外的工作负载规模、全新的随机数序列以及接近数值决策边界的输入。

sents.zh: 这些结果不会被用于相应的搜索运行，而是被排除在外，不会用来指导提案。

paragraphs.en: Formal analysis. The Lean package [ 25 ] verifies selected requirements, called contracts, rather than whole-program equivalence. GPU assignment proofs ensure each input is processed exactly once and retains its assigned random-sequence identifier. Restricted code generation translates the GPU work-assignment rules checked in Lean into executable code. CBMC checks C array indexing within bounded executions [ 26 ] . Physlib/HepLean and Mathlib provide reusable physics and mathematics proofs [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] . Alive2 and VOLTA check code-fragment equivalence in separate demonstrations [ 30 , 31 ] . These guarantees cover selected requirements and fragments, not complete GPU programs.
paragraphs.zh: 形式化分析。 Lean 包 [ 25 ] 验证的是被称为“契约”的特定要求，而非整个程序的等价性。 GPU 分配证明确保每个输入仅被处理一次，并保留其分配的随机序列标识符。 受限代码生成将 Lean 中已验证的 GPU 工作分配规则转换为可执行代码。 CBMC 在受约束的执行过程中检查 C 语言的数组索引操作 [ 26 ] 。 Physlib/HepLean 和 Mathlib 提供了可重用的物理与数学证明 [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] 。 Alive2 和 VOLTA 在独立的演示中验证代码片段的等价性 [ 30 , 31 ] 。 这些保证仅涵盖特定的要求和代码片段，而非完整的 GPU 程序。

sents.en: Formal analysis.
sents.zh: 形式化分析。

sents.en: The Lean package [ 25 ] verifies selected requirements, called contracts, rather than whole-program equivalence.
sents.zh: Lean 包 [ 25 ] 验证的是被称为“契约”的特定要求，而非整个程序的等价性。

sents.zh: GPU 分配证明确保每个输入仅被处理一次，并保留其分配的随机序列标识符。

sents.en: Restricted code generation translates the GPU work-assignment rules checked in Lean into executable code.
sents.zh: 受限代码生成将 Lean 中已验证的 GPU 工作分配规则转换为可执行代码。

sents.en: CBMC checks C array indexing within bounded executions [ 26 ] .
sents.zh: CBMC 在受约束的执行过程中检查 C 语言的数组索引操作 [ 26 ] 。

sents.zh: Physlib/HepLean 和 Mathlib 提供了可重用的物理与数学证明 [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] 。

sents.zh: Alive2 和 VOLTA 在独立的演示中验证代码片段的等价性 [ 30 , 31 ] 。

sents.en: These guarantees cover selected requirements and fragments, not complete GPU programs.
sents.zh: 这些保证仅涵盖特定的要求和代码片段，而非完整的 GPU 程序。

paragraphs.en: Execution-based validation. Differential tests compare reference and candidate outputs on matching inputs within fixed numerical tolerances. Where contracts require, they also check exact output counts and random-number consumption. Physics checks test conservation laws and valid output ranges. Compute Sanitizer detects GPU memory-access and synchronization errors [ 32 ] . Statistical tests compare selected output distributions from independent samples. Nsight Compute profiles GPU execution [ 33 ] . Acceptance means passing required checks within their stated domains, not universal program equivalence.
paragraphs.zh: 基于执行的验证。 差异测试在固定数值容限内，对匹配输入下的参考输出和候选输出进行比较。 若合同有要求，这些测试还会检查精确的输出数量以及随机数的消耗情况。 物理检查用于测试守恒定律和有效的输出范围。 计算净化器可检测 GPU 内存访问和同步错误 [ 32 ] 。 统计测试比较来自独立样本的选定输出分布。 Nsight Compute 可分析 GPU 执行过程 [ 33 ] 。 通过验收意味着在规定的定义域内满足必要的检查，而非程序完全等价。

sents.en: Execution-based validation.
sents.zh: 基于执行的验证。

sents.en: Differential tests compare reference and candidate outputs on matching inputs within fixed numerical tolerances.
sents.zh: 差异测试在固定数值容限内，对匹配输入下的参考输出和候选输出进行比较。

sents.zh: 物理检查用于测试守恒定律和有效的输出范围。

sents.zh: 计算净化器可检测 GPU 内存访问和同步错误 [ 32 ] 。

sents.en: Statistical tests compare selected output distributions from independent samples.
sents.zh: 统计测试比较来自独立样本的选定输出分布。

sents.en: Nsight Compute profiles GPU execution [ 33 ] .
sents.zh: Nsight Compute 可分析 GPU 执行过程 [ 33 ] 。

sents.zh: 通过验收意味着在规定的定义域内满足必要的检查，而非程序完全等价。

paragraphs.en: We study two complementary Geant4 functions as case studies, translating CPU-only C++ functions rather than the complete simulation. The Compton function computes particle energies and directions after a photon scatters from an electron. The Fermi function assigns energy and motion to fragments of an atomic nucleus. Optimization must satisfy the evaluation criteria in Section 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们以两个互补的 Geant4 函数作为案例研究，将其仅使用 CPU 的 C++ 函数进行转换，而非转换完整的模拟。 康普顿函数用于计算光子从电子散射后的粒子能量和方向。 费米函数为原子核的碎片分配能量和运动状态。 优化必须满足第 3 节中的评估标准。

sents.en: We study two complementary Geant4 functions as case studies, translating CPU-only C++ functions rather than the complete simulation.
sents.zh: 我们以两个互补的 Geant4 函数作为案例研究，将其仅使用 CPU 的 C++ 函数进行转换，而非转换完整的模拟。

sents.en: The Compton function computes particle energies and directions after a photon scatters from an electron.
sents.zh: 康普顿函数用于计算光子从电子散射后的粒子能量和方向。

sents.en: The Fermi function assigns energy and motion to fragments of an atomic nucleus.
sents.zh: 费米函数为原子核的碎片分配能量和运动状态。

sents.en: Optimization must satisfy the evaluation criteria in Section 3 .
sents.zh: 优化必须满足第 3 节中的评估标准。

paragraphs.en: We chose Compton because Celeritas has an expert GPU implementation, and Fermi because, to our knowledge, it has no matching GPU implementation already available. This lets us test both improving on existing GPU code and generating GPU code where none is provided by Celeritas. Celeritas therefore serves as our expert reference [ 8 ] for the first function. The Fermi case also reduces reliance on a comparison where the LLM may have seen the Celeritas code during pretraining.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择 Compton，因为 Celeritas 有专门的 GPU 实现；而选择 Fermi，则是因为据我们所知，目前还没有现成的对应 GPU 实现。 这使我们既能测试如何改进现有的 GPU 代码，也能测试在 Celeritas 未提供 GPU 代码的情况下生成 GPU 代码。 因此，对于第一个函数，Celeritas 充当了我们的专家参考 [ 8 ]。 Fermi 的情况也减少了对一种比较的依赖：即 LLM 可能在预训练期间已经见过 Celeritas 的代码。

sents.en: We chose Compton because Celeritas has an expert GPU implementation, and Fermi because, to our knowledge, it has no matching GPU implementation already available.
sents.zh: 我们选择 Compton，因为 Celeritas 有专门的 GPU 实现；而选择 Fermi，则是因为据我们所知，目前还没有现成的对应 GPU 实现。

sents.en: This lets us test both improving on existing GPU code and generating GPU code where none is provided by Celeritas.
sents.zh: 这使我们既能测试如何改进现有的 GPU 代码，也能测试在 Celeritas 未提供 GPU 代码的情况下生成 GPU 代码。

sents.zh: Fermi 的情况也减少了对一种比较的依赖：即 LLM 可能在预训练期间已经见过 Celeritas 的代码。

paragraphs.en: We benchmark the CPU reference, CDES-generated GPU code, and Celeritas where available, using approximately 250,000 inputs on a 10 GB partition of an NVIDIA H100 GPU. Comparisons within each table use matching inputs and test programs with repeated measurements. Table 1 sums separately measured data conversion, transfers, and GPU computation. CPU timings include allocation, whereas GPU timings use preallocated buffers. Table 2 directly measures transfers and computation in a shared benchmark with different supporting code and launch settings. Its GPU buffers are also preallocated. Absolute times should therefore be compared within each table. Speedup is reference time divided by generated-code time, and throughput is inputs processed per second. Both tables exclude search and evaluation runtime. We use GPT-5.6-Sol with medium reasoning, with total model-call costs under $10.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上 10 GB 分区中的约 250,000 个输入，对 CPU 参考代码、CDES 生成的 GPU 代码以及可用的 Celeritas 进行了基准测试。 每个表格内的比较均使用匹配的输入和测试程序，并进行了重复测量。 表 1 分别汇总了单独测量的数据转换、传输和 GPU 计算时间。 CPU 计时包含分配时间，而 GPU 计时则使用预分配的缓冲区。 表 2 在一个共享基准测试中直接测量了传输和计算时间，该测试使用了不同的支持代码和启动设置。 其 GPU 缓冲区也是预分配的。 因此，绝对时间应在每个表格内部进行比较。 加速比是参考时间与生成代码时间之比，而吞吐量是每秒处理的输入数量。 两个表格均未包含搜索和评估的运行时间。 我们使用 GPT-5.6-Sol 的中度推理模式，总模型调用成本低于 10 美元。

sents.zh: 我们使用 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上 10 GB 分区中的约 250,000 个输入，对 CPU 参考代码、CDES 生成的 GPU 代码以及可用的 Celeritas 进行了基准测试。

sents.en: Comparisons within each table use matching inputs and test programs with repeated measurements.
sents.zh: 每个表格内的比较均使用匹配的输入和测试程序，并进行了重复测量。

sents.en: Table 1 sums separately measured data conversion, transfers, and GPU computation.
sents.zh: 表 1 分别汇总了单独测量的数据转换、传输和 GPU 计算时间。

sents.en: CPU timings include allocation, whereas GPU timings use preallocated buffers.
sents.zh: CPU 计时包含分配时间，而 GPU 计时则使用预分配的缓冲区。

sents.en: Table 2 directly measures transfers and computation in a shared benchmark with different supporting code and launch settings.
sents.zh: 表 2 在一个共享基准测试中直接测量了传输和计算时间，该测试使用了不同的支持代码和启动设置。

sents.en: Its GPU buffers are also preallocated.
sents.zh: 其 GPU 缓冲区也是预分配的。

sents.en: Absolute times should therefore be compared within each table.
sents.zh: 因此，绝对时间应在每个表格内部进行比较。

sents.en: Speedup is reference time divided by generated-code time, and throughput is inputs processed per second.
sents.zh: 加速比是参考时间与生成代码时间之比，而吞吐量是每秒处理的输入数量。

sents.en: Both tables exclude search and evaluation runtime.
sents.zh: 两个表格均未包含搜索和评估的运行时间。

sents.en: We use GPT-5.6-Sol with medium reasoning, with total model-call costs under $10.
sents.zh: 我们使用 GPT-5.6-Sol 的中度推理模式，总模型调用成本低于 10 美元。

paragraphs.en: Performance. CDES-generated GPU code achieves 13.78 × \times and 23.54 × \times speedups over the CPU versions under the standalone timing protocol (Table 1 ). In the shared Compton benchmark, GPU throughput is 14.9% higher than Celeritas, while execution time including transfers is approximately 3.0% lower (Table 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 性能。 在独立计时协议下，CDES 生成的 GPU 代码相比 CPU 版本实现了 13.78 × \times 和 23.54 × \times 的性能提升（表 1）。 在共享 Compton 基准测试中，GPU 的吞吐量比 Celeritas 高 14.9%，而包含数据传输的执行时间则短约 3.0%（表 2）。

sents.en: Performance.
sents.zh: 性能。

sents.en: CDES-generated GPU code achieves 13.78 × \times and 23.54 × \times speedups over the CPU versions under the standalone timing protocol (Table 1 ).
sents.zh: 在独立计时协议下，CDES 生成的 GPU 代码相比 CPU 版本实现了 13.78 × \times 和 23.54 × \times 的性能提升（表 1）。

sents.en: In the shared Compton benchmark, GPU throughput is 14.9% higher than Celeritas, while execution time including transfers is approximately 3.0% lower (Table 2 ).
sents.zh: 在共享 Compton 基准测试中，GPU 的吞吐量比 Celeritas 高 14.9%，而包含数据传输的执行时间则短约 3.0%（表 2）。

paragraphs.en: Optimization patterns. Generated code reuses earlier calculations and simplifies repeated work. In Compton, it keeps a value that Celeritas computes inside a helper (Figure 2 ). In Fermi, it replaces selected power calculations with multiplication, retaining the original calculation where rounding could change a decision. Reported speedups measure complete functions, not individual changes.
paragraphs.zh: 优化模式。 生成的代码会复用早期的计算结果，并简化重复性工作。 在 Compton 中，它会保留 Celeritas 在辅助函数内部计算出的一个值（图 2）。 在 Fermi 中，它会将选定的幂运算替换为乘法，但在四舍五入可能改变决策的情况下，仍保留原始计算。 报告的速度提升是针对完整函数的测量结果，而非单个改动。

sents.en: Optimization patterns.
sents.zh: 优化模式。

sents.en: Generated code reuses earlier calculations and simplifies repeated work.
sents.zh: 生成的代码会复用早期的计算结果，并简化重复性工作。

sents.en: In Compton, it keeps a value that Celeritas computes inside a helper (Figure 2 ).
sents.zh: 在 Compton 中，它会保留 Celeritas 在辅助函数内部计算出的一个值（图 2）。

sents.zh: 报告的速度提升是针对完整函数的测量结果，而非单个改动。

paragraphs.en: Combining with Celeritas. We combine Celeritas’s code for selecting particle energies with our code for calculating directions and writing outputs. This hybrid increases GPU throughput by 16.1% over Celeritas (Table 2 ). It improves GPU throughput over our generated code by 1.2% , measured as the median gain across six paired timing rounds, showing that the two implementations offer complementary improvements and an opportunity for human–AI collaboration.
paragraphs.zh: 与 Celeritas 结合。 我们将 Celeritas 用于选择粒子能量的代码，与我们用于计算方向和写入输出的代码相结合。 这种混合方案使 GPU 吞吐量相比 Celeritas 提升了 16.1%（见表 2）。 与我们的生成代码相比，它使 GPU 吞吐量提升了 1.2%，该提升量是通过六轮配对计时测试的中位数增益测得的，表明这两种实现提供了互补的优化，也为人类与人工智能的合作创造了机会。

sents.en: Combining with Celeritas.
sents.zh: 与 Celeritas 结合。

sents.en: We combine Celeritas’s code for selecting particle energies with our code for calculating directions and writing outputs.
sents.zh: 我们将 Celeritas 用于选择粒子能量的代码，与我们用于计算方向和写入输出的代码相结合。

sents.zh: 这种混合方案使 GPU 吞吐量相比 Celeritas 提升了 16.1%（见表 2）。

paragraphs.en: Ablation. We compare the evolutionary search with and without certificate feedback, using the same correctness checks (Table 3 ). Certificates increase the fraction of proposals that compile and pass these checks from 55% to 90% . The fraction of proposals that also improve throughput by over 10% increases from 50% to 80% . Search without certificates still produces useful candidates at lower total API cost, while certificate feedback improves the passing rate and lowers cost per passing proposal by 10.7% .
paragraphs.zh: 消融研究。 我们对比了有证书反馈和无证书反馈的进化搜索，并使用相同的正确性检查（表3）。 证书使能够通过这些检查的提案比例从55%提升至90%。 同时能将吞吐量提升超过10%的提案比例从50%提升至80%。 无证书的搜索在较低的总API成本下仍能生成有用的候选方案，而证书反馈则提高了通过率，并将每个通过提案的成本降低了10.7%。

sents.en: Ablation.
sents.zh: 消融研究。

sents.en: We compare the evolutionary search with and without certificate feedback, using the same correctness checks (Table 3 ).
sents.zh: 我们对比了有证书反馈和无证书反馈的进化搜索，并使用相同的正确性检查（表3）。

paragraphs.en: We present a proof-of-concept approach toward reliably and scalably porting large legacy scientific codebases, demonstrated on two Geant4 functions while enforcing a flexible range of correctness requirements. The generated code exhibits optimization patterns that improve on expert-written implementations, and combining it with Celeritas components shows complementary benefits from human–AI collaboration. CDES connects conflict detection, certificate validation, and enforced search control for scientific optimization. Future work will test how the cost and correctness benefits of certificates vary across functions and optimization difficulty, extend evaluation to larger portions of Geant4, and incorporate requirements needed for projects such as Celeritas.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种概念验证方法，用于可靠且可扩展地迁移大型遗留科学代码库，并通过在两个 Geant4 函数上实施灵活的准确性要求进行了演示。 生成的代码展现出优于专家编写的实现方式的优化模式，而将其与 Celeritas 组件结合使用，则体现了人类与人工智能协作所带来的互补性优势。 CDES 将冲突检测、证书验证和强制性搜索控制相结合，以支持科学计算中的优化。 未来的工作将测试证书在成本与准确性方面的收益如何因函数和优化难度而异，并将评估范围扩展到 Geant4 的更大部分，同时纳入类似 Celeritas 项目所需的要求。

sents.en: We present a proof-of-concept approach toward reliably and scalably porting large legacy scientific codebases, demonstrated on two Geant4 functions while enforcing a flexible range of correctness requirements.

sents.en: The generated code exhibits optimization patterns that improve on expert-written implementations, and combining it with Celeritas components shows complementary benefits from human–AI collaboration.
